top_stories.title: Tamil Nadu government promoted seven IAS officers without Centre’s approval, Union Ministry tells Madras High Court - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **Union Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions** stated that the Tamil Nadu government promoted seven Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officers to the grade of Chief Secretary without its approval.  The **Madras High Court** dismissed a public interest litigation petition challenging this promotion order, stating that only those directly affected by the promotions could file a case. The **Union Ministry** will take independent action regarding the promotions.

top_stories.title: Excise seizes 23.42 grams of suspected heroin from lodge in Perumbavoor - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Excise department** officials seized 23.42 grams of suspected heroin from a lodge on PP Road in Perumbavoor, where **Noushad Alam**, an Assam native, had checked in.  The drug was found in 240 tiny containers and empty containers were also discovered.  **Alam** fled the room before the raid but investigators believe he has stayed at the lodge previously. In a separate incident, **Perumbavoor police** arrested **Shahida Khatoon**, a 25-year-old Assam woman, with 1.3 grams of suspected heroin during a raid as part of Operation Toofan.

top_stories.title: EC begins preparations for bypolls to five vacant Assembly seats in T.N. - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) Archana Patnaik** has written to District Collectors seeking details of Returning Officers (ROs) and Assistant Returning Officers (AROs) for the five Assembly seats vacated by members who resigned from the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly. The resignations, following those of **Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay**, three AIADMK rebel MLAs, and another rebel MLA, have triggered by-election preparations.  The Election Commission of India (ECI) may announce by-elections within six months.

top_stories.title: T.N. CM Vijay calls on President, Vice President in New Delhi - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **C. Joseph Vijay**, Tamil Nadu Chief Minister, visited **President Droupadi Murmu** at Rashtrapati Bhavan in New Delhi on Wednesday. He also met with **Vice-President C.P. Radhakrishnan**, **Congress Parliamentary Party chairperson Sonia Gandhi**, and **Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi**.  Vijay's visit included discussions with leaders from various political parties, including the Communist Party of India (CPI) and its general secretary **D. Raja**.

top_stories.title: Protecting federalism must be the INDIA bloc’s ‘glue’ - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Omar Abdullah**, Chief Minister of Jammu and Kashmir, stated at the June 8, 2026 meeting of the **INDIA** alliance that the **Congress party** is uniquely positioned to act as a unifying force due to its presence in all Indian states.  While other parties are limited to specific regions, the **Congress**'s nationwide reach makes it crucial for the alliance's success, according to all participants.  Despite criticisms of the **Congress**, including concerns about electoral support and potential conflicts with allies, the party is widely recognized as essential for the bloc's advancement.

top_stories.title: Why TVK is eager to woo AIADMK cadre - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **The Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK)**, a new political party formed by defectors from the **All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (AIADMK)**, has been attracting former AIADMK members and officials.  **Aadhav Arjuna**, a prominent figure in the TVK, stated that it is essentially a "parent body" to the AIADMK. This influx of defectors has led some to question whether the **TVK** is attempting to strengthen its organizational network by recruiting from the **AIADMK**.

top_stories.title: SEZs in Tamil Nadu region register record export worth ₹2.2 lakh crore in 2025-26 - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **Special Economic Zones (SEZ)** of Tamil Nadu-Anadaman and Nicobar Islands-Puducherry (TAP) Region achieved a record high export value of ₹2.2 lakh crore in the financial year 2025-26, according to **Alex Paul Menon**, the **MEPZ Development Commissioner**. This represents an increase from ₹2.03 lakh crore in the previous fiscal year and is attributed to various initiatives aimed at improving ease of doing business. The region boasts 62 functional SEZs with a cumulative investment of ₹82,844 crore, attracting significant investments from companies like High Glory Footwear India Private Limited and Mylan Laboratories.  The TAP region's exports have grown significantly since 2014-15, creating over 6.26 lakh jobs and contributing to the overall forex earnings of the country.

top_stories.title: Trump congratulates Modi on becoming India's longest-serving elected PM - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **President Donald Trump** congratulated **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** on becoming India's longest-serving Prime Minister, surpassing the record of Jawaharlal Nehru.  **Trump** praised **Modi** as a "strong, healthy, and wise man" with many years of success ahead.

top_stories.title: Ola driver held for assaulting elderly man who objected to him spitting on road in Thane | Mumbai News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: An **Ola** driver, **Nishant Dhar Shukla**, was arrested for allegedly assaulting a 70-year-old man who objected to him spitting on the road near Jupiter Hospital in Thane. The incident sparked outrage after videos of the assault surfaced online and prompted calls for action from **Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde**.  **Shinde** directed police to investigate the case and consider an attempt-to-murder charge, while **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis** condemned the violence and promised swift action against anti-social elements.

top_stories.title: Jawaharlal Nehru was a visionary leader, there can’t be any comparison with Narendra Modi: Sharad Pawar | Mumbai News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Sharad Pawar**, NCP (SP) president, stated that there is no comparison between **Jawaharlal Nehru** and **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**.  Pawar emphasized the distinct achievements of both leaders during his speech at the party's 27th foundation day celebration in Mumbai. He also highlighted Indira Gandhi's dedication to national interests and condemned the controversial remarks made by Maharashtra BJP minister Girish Mahajan regarding Operation Blue Star, stating that it was a sacrifice for the nation.
